info.name: HollyHR - Start Here
info.description:
Get from a scoped HollyHR API key to a useful SME HR workflow in four requests.

1. Confirm the connected workspace and granted scopes.
2. Read the people directory.
3. See who is away.
4. Build a bounded pay-period change pack.

Set `baseUrl` and `bearerToken` locally before sending a request. The committed and published collection never contains a credential. Begin with a disposable tenant and grant only the scopes required by the requests you intend to run.

Quickstart: https://developers.hollyhr.com/quickstart
API documentation: https://developers.hollyhr.com
Runnable examples: https://github.com/hollyhr/hollyhr-api-examples

request.description: The fastest first 200 response. Confirms the organisation, environment, key identity and explicitly granted scopes without returning employee records.
Requires `people:read`. Returns a deny-by-default projection with opaque public IDs and cursor pagination.
Requires `time_off:read`. Returns approved, permission-safe absence information for the selected period without exposing medical content or raw special-category labels.
Requires the export's documented read scopes. Produces a bounded pay-period change pack from HollyHR's current records for review before any downstream payroll action.
